signature.composition: tag left and three blocks plus B right

prompt: One SQUARE 1:1 flat software icon on white for tag buffer byte size. At left a large blue tag with a single clear hole. To its right show three LARGE orange square blocks stacked like a short ascending count, with a large black capital B above the stack to indicate the count is in bytes. All B counters and gaps between blocks must be big enough at 30x18. No other text, no ruler ticks, no shadows, generous margins.
